UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Persistent BTech student profile and active semester pointer owned by a specific authenticated user.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated student owner.

customBranchName.description: Custom branch name if branch is Other.

careerGoal.description: Target engineering career role or field.

knownSkills.description: List of skills already known by the student (max 30).

weeklyStudyHours.description: Available weekly study hours between 1 and 60.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

SemesterRecord.title: SemesterRecord
SemesterRecord.description: Semester-specific persisted roadmap, learning plans, skills, projects, opportunities, and completion progress stored using native Firestore maps and lists.

semesterId.description: Unique semester identifier (e.g. sem_1 to sem_8).

userId.description: Owner user UID matching parent user document.

academicYear.description: Academic year corresponding to this semester.

branch.description: Engineering branch for this semester record.

careerGoal.description: Target career goal during this semester.

weeklyStudyHours.description: Weekly study hours allocated for this semester.

preferredLearningMethod.description: Preferred learning method for this semester.

subjects.description: Academic subjects studied in this semester (max 15).

status.description: Semester lifecycle status: active or completed.

subjectBridges.description: Native list of subject-to-real-world bridge map objects (max 15).

monthlyPlans.description: Native list of monthly learning plan map objects (max 6).

weeklyPlans.description: Native list of weekly learning plan map objects (max 20).

skills.description: Native list of skill and resource map objects (max 30).

projects.description: Native list of semester project map objects (max 10).

opportunities.description: Native list of internship and hackathon map objects (max 15).

placementTasks.description: Native list of placement preparation task map objects (max 20).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the semester record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the semester record was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores each student's persistent profile and current active semester pointer.

/users/{userId}/semesters/{semesterId}.description: Stores each semester's generated roadmap, tasks, skills, projects, opportunities, and progress for the owning student.
